messages:
Aisha Patel: FYI Horizon Labs asked for a formal explanation of how we measure uptime/latency for their onboarding SLO. They want to know if maintenance windows are excluded and how credits are calculated. Can we confirm by EOD? :thinking:
Tom Nguyen: I can pull the measurement config. We use a 30-day rolling window measured at per-route level, exclude scheduled maintenance flagged in the ticketing system, and blackout periods are applied per-customer config.
Javier Morales: Correct. Also note our latency SLO is p50/p95 depending on plan — Horizon requested p50 200ms for their L1 routes. We need to validate telemetry mapping (route names) before we sign that in the contract.
Keiko Sato: Their renewal is in 45 days, they're pushing for a commercial credit clause if we miss >0.05% uptime monthly. That seems tight. Thoughts on negotiation? :grimacing:
Tom Nguyen: Can we provide sample export for last 90 days so they can eyeball historical performance? I'll attach CSV. Also confirm the exact metric: 'successful_tokens' vs 'success_rate' — which drives credit calc.
Aisha Patel: Yes please. Also can we get a one-pager (customer-facing) explaining measurement + example credit calc so account team can share? Minimal math.
Javier Morales: I can draft an ops note. Example calc snippet:
```
# credit calc example (simplified)
period = 30  # days
total_minutes = period * 24 * 60
downtime_minutes = 10  # sample
availability = (total_minutes - downtime_minutes) / total_minutes
if availability < 0.9995:
    credit = min( (0.9995 - availability) * 100000, 5000 )
```
Keiko Sato: That looks helpful. Can you include how we handle multi-region failover (do we use weighted routing or single-region SLA?)
Javier Morales: For Hosted customers we have region-level SLOs and an account-level aggregated SLO that weights by traffic. For Dedicated/Private we default to customer-configured region set — we'll note that.
Aisha Patel: Next steps:
- Tom: export last 90d route-level CSV and drop in the thread (or share link)
- Javier: ops one-pager + calc example by tomorrow
- Keiko: align negotiation points and propose phrasing for credits
I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough with Horizon next week. 
Tom Nguyen: uploaded: https://files.redwood.test/horizon/metrics-90d.csv :paperclip:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window for 2025-07-12 02:00-03:00 UTC flagged for Horizon Labs (ticket #7892)
Keiko Sato: Noted — we'll mark that as excluded in the sample report. :+1:
Aisha Patel: Thanks team. If we can get the one-pager and CSV by EOD tomorrow I can draft the external email. 
Tom Nguyen: on it.
Javier Morales: Draft will include wording: 'scheduled maintenance and agreed blackout windows are excluded from uptime calculations. Credits are calculated on rolling 30-day windows at the per-route level unless otherwise specified in your contract.'
Keiko Sato: Great — also add a short FAQ: "what happens during cross-region failover" and "how quickly we notify customers".
Aisha Patel: Perfect. I'll loop in solutions-engineering if they want to review the calc wording.
Keiko Sato: ping @Riley (solutions-eng) once draft is ready.
Aisha Patel: cc: Riley. End of thread.
